personal.name: Panha Teng
personal.title: Senior Backend Developer · Financial Systems & Architecture
personal.tagline: Building mission-critical Web APIs, banking integrations, and resilient workflows (.NET, C#, Java, Python).
personal.bio: Backend developer with experience in financial systems, mostly using C#/.NET, building Web APIs and services used by web and mobile front-ends. I've worked on backend workflow design, cross-functional integration, authorization and security (OAuth2, JWT, IdentityServer, AES/RSA/HMAC), performance optimization, and production support for banking and digital payment platforms. Hands-on experience with PHP, Python, and RESTful API design, front-end basics (HTML, JavaScript, CSS), and Java/Spring Boot through personal projects and formal training.
